Premium Dehydrated Coriander Leaves Powder for B2B Food Manufacturing

Dehydrated coriander leaves powder is a premium, shelf-stable green herb ingredient manufactured from carefully selected coriander leaves and processed to retain their characteristic aroma, vibrant color, and savory herbal flavor. Tradenest Naturals supplies this vital ingredient to commercial food manufacturers, spice blenders, food service providers, exporters, private label brands, and wholesale distributors seeking consistent performance in industrial formulations. As an established dehydrated coriander leaves powder supplier and dehydrated coriander leaves powder exporter from India, we provide both standard and customized specifications tailored to domestic and international regulatory requirements. Our industrial-grade powder is engineered for manufacturing applications where fresh coriander is difficult to procure, store, portion, or standardize. It integrates seamlessly into dry seasoning mixes, commercial spice systems, instant food lines, snack coatings, bakery goods, and ready-to-cook formulations. Bulk dehydrated coriander leaves powder is available in multiple mesh sizes and commercial packaging formats, subject to order volume, inventory availability, and precise customer parameters. B2B buyers can contact Tradenest Naturals directly to request product samples, technical documentation, private label consultations, or comprehensive export quotations.

Product Overview and Characteristics

Dehydrated coriander leaves powder is produced by cleaning and drying fresh coriander leaves under strictly controlled processing conditions, followed by precision grinding and sieving. This specialized manufacturing process drastically reduces moisture levels while successfully preserving the functional, sensory characteristics of the raw herb. Compared to raw, fresh coriander, our dried format offers significantly easier handling, lower storage complexity, absolute portion control, and an extended usable shelf life when packaged and stored correctly. The finished product is supplied as a free-flowing green to greenish-brown powder carrying a fresh, authentic herbaceous coriander aroma. Natural variations in flavor intensity can occur depending on the agricultural crop, harvesting season, leaf maturity, drying parameters, and particle size. Tradenest Naturals ensures strict batch-to-batch consistency through rigorous raw material selection, tight process controls, mechanical sieving, thorough inspection, and robust traceability procedures.

Manufacturing and Processing Methodology

Fresh coriander leaves are sourced directly from approved agricultural supply channels and subjected to comprehensive receiving inspections. The leaves are meticulously sorted to eliminate foreign matter and unsuitable plant material, followed by deep cleaning using industry-standard food-processing protocols. Controlled industrial dehydration reduces moisture content to a stable threshold optimal for fine milling and long-term storage. Post-drying, the leaves are pulverized and passed through a calibrated sieve to achieve the exact particle size requested by the buyer.
  • Rigorous raw material selection and receiving inspection
  • Detailed sorting and complete removal of unwanted foreign matter
  • Hygienic cleaning and controlled industrial dehydration
  • Fine grinding and pulverizing to the required powder grade
  • Calibrated sieving for guaranteed particle-size consistency
  • Comprehensive batch inspection, secure packing, compliant labeling, and end-to-end traceability
Standard processing is entirely additive-free unless a customer-approved formulation explicitly dictates otherwise. Any customized treatments, specialized mesh sizes, proprietary blends, or unique packaging configurations are thoroughly reviewed and confirmed prior to commercial production.

Typical Technical Specifications

Typical commercial specifications are outlined below for your product planning and R&D purposes. Final technical parameters may vary depending on the agreed product grade, target destination-market regulations, raw material seasonality, and specific customer quality agreements.
  • Mesh Size: Typically 60 to 100 mesh; custom particle sizes are available upon technical consultation.
  • Moisture Content: Typically not more than 7% on a standard commercial basis.
  • Purity: Typically 99% minimum for pure coriander leaf material, excluding normal analytical tolerances and subject to agreed specifications.
  • Appearance: Fine powder ranging from green to greenish-brown.
  • Flavor Profile: Characteristic coriander leaf taste featuring a fresh, herbal, and mildly citrus-like profile.
  • Additives: Zero added colors, preservatives, or fillers in our standard additive-free formulation unless agreed upon in writing.
Microbiological profiles, pesticide-residue thresholds, heavy-metal limits, allergen declarations, and other specific quality parameters can be negotiated based on the buyer's technical requirements and the statutory regulations of the destination country. Comprehensive product testing and analytical documentation are arranged according to confirmed order specifications and agreed commercial terms.

Quality Assurance, Compliance, and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals adheres to documented food-safety and quality management systems encompassing raw material inspection, strict moisture control, hygienic plant handling, clear batch identification, ongoing process monitoring, packaging checks, and detailed finished-product reviews. Every outgoing shipment is prepared complete with full traceability data and labeling appropriate to the agreed purchase order. Standard export documentation typically includes commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and additional paperwork mandated by the buyer or destination market, subject to applicable trade regulations and shipment terms. Certifications and specific quality standards vary depending on the exact manufacturing site, product grade, customer specification, and destination-country requirements. We do not represent unverified certifications for specific orders. Buyers are strongly encouraged to communicate mandatory certifications, plant audits, formal declarations, testing protocols, allergen statements, or specific regulatory documents during the quotation phase so availability can be verified prior to production.

Industrial Applications

As a trusted dried coriander leaf supplier, our powder is ideally suited for food formulations requiring dependable, uniform herb flavor in a convenient, dry format. Key applications include:
  • Commercial seasoning blends, dry spice mixes, curry powders, and instant masala systems
  • Instant soups, dehydrated noodle blocks, liquid sauces, gravies, culinary dips, and ready-to-cook meals
  • Snack coatings, traditional namkeen, savory extruded snacks, and fried snack seasoners
  • Chutney powders, dry herb mixes, wet and dry marinades, and specialized culinary premixes
  • Bakery formulations and savory baked goods, including crackers, artisan breads, and savory biscuits
  • Food service operations, restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens, and QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) food preparation
  • Private label herb retail packs and consumer-ready retail spice packaging
  • Custom seasoning blends and specialized food ingredient formulations
Optimal dosage depends on the desired flavor strength, product formulation type, processing parameters, and the presence of complementary herbs or spices. Industrial product trials are strongly recommended prior to commercial scale-up, especially for high-temperature cooking applications, wet processing systems, or formulations requiring a rigidly defined color and aroma profile.

B2B Buyer Value Proposition

  • Enhanced Operational Convenience: A ready-to-use dry powder completely eliminates intensive washing, chopping, and fresh-herb preparation labor.
  • Extended Storage Potential: Controlled moisture levels and protective packaging ensure a substantially longer shelf life compared to fresh herbs.
  • Cost and Process Efficiency: Dry dosing streamlines inventory planning, reduces labor overheads, and guarantees absolute portion control.
  • Consistent Formulation Performance: A clearly defined powder grade supports repeatable industrial blending and predictable commercial production.
  • Mitigated Seasonal Dependence: This shelf-stable format safeguards your supply chain against fresh coriander market price spikes and availability fluctuations.
  • Flexible Sourcing Solutions: A wide array of pack sizes, mesh options, and private label formats accommodate diverse business models.

Packaging Formats and Shelf Life

Packaging materials are specifically selected to protect the delicate powder from moisture, microbial contamination, light degradation, and physical damage throughout storage and international transit. Available commercial formats include food-grade stand-up pouches, durable PET jars, robust HDPE containers, lined corrugated cartons, and export-ready multi-wall bulk bags. Inner food-grade liners and outer packaging can be fully customized based on order quantities, transportation modes, warehouse conditions, and specific customer requirements. The typical shelf life is up to 12 months from the manufacturing date when packed in proper moisture-resistant packaging and stored under recommended environmental conditions. The exact expiry period is clearly indicated on the product label and agreed product specification sheet. Overall shelf-life performance ultimately depends on maintaining packaging integrity, controlling relative humidity and ambient temperature, minimizing light exposure, and adhering to proper warehouse handling practices.

MOQ, Lead Times, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for dehydrated coriander leaves powder? Our standard MOQ is generally 25 kg for standard bulk supplies, though smaller trial quantities may be accommodated subject to stock availability and packaging format. Private label manufacturing, custom packaging printing, specialized mesh grading, bespoke testing protocols, and OEM orders typically require a higher MOQ to ensure efficient procurement and production runs. Final MOQs are officially confirmed following a thorough review of your required volume, packaging style, destination, and technical specifications. Standard lead times typically range from 7 to 15 working days following formal specification approval, order confirmation, packaging sign-off, and receipt of the agreed payment or purchase documentation. Ready stock orders may be dispatched sooner, whereas fully customized or private label orders may require extended lead times. To request a professional product sample or commercial quotation, please provide your required volume, mesh size, packaging preferences, destination country, intended application, certification prerequisites, and target delivery schedule. Our technical and sales teams will review your submission and provide prompt, practical commercial guidance.

Storage and Handling Guidelines

Store the product in a cool, dry, clean, and well-ventilated warehouse environment away from direct sunlight, extreme heat sources, strong industrial odors, and chemical contaminants. Ensure packages are kept tightly sealed immediately after opening, and always utilize clean, dry utensils during handling operations. Strictly avoid exposure to high ambient humidity, as excess moisture may induce caking, premature aroma loss, discoloration, or reduced shelf-life performance.

We focus heavily on transparent communication, consistent product quality, rapid sampling, and mutually beneficial long-term B2B partnerships.
